# `ggproto` 对象

## ggplot2 的内部结构

<https://ggplot2-book.org/internals.html>

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- ToothGrowth
df$dose <- as.character(df$dose)
p <- ggplot(data = df,mapping = aes(dose,len,fill = supp)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean",position = position_dodge(1))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 40))
p
```

## 图形坐标

```{r}
layer_data(plot = p ,i = 1) |> DT:::datatable()
```

## `ggproto`

```{r}
prototype()
```
